messages.content: Teach compact XAUUSD market-structure principles for later LoRA examples.

{"principle_id":"principle_001_location_before_signal","source_policy":"Distilled from human doctrine and trading literature principles; no copied book text.","task":"Learn one market-structure principle before reading chart examples.","topic":"location before signal"}

{"guardrail":"Apply only when confirmed by closed candles and current market context.","lesson":"Judge where price is relative to higher-timeframe structure before treating lower-timeframe movement as actionable.","practice":"Read H4/H1 first, then M30/M15 path, then M5/M1 timing.","principle_id":"principle_001_location_before_signal"}
Teach compact XAUUSD market-structure principles for later LoRA examples.

{"principle_id":"principle_002_levels_are_zones","source_policy":"Distilled from human doctrine and trading literature principles; no copied book text.","task":"Learn one market-structure principle before reading chart examples.","topic":"support and resistance zones"}

{"guardrail":"Apply only when confirmed by closed candles and current market context.","lesson":"A level is an investigation zone. It needs a current closed-price response before it can guide a trade.","practice":"Separate touch, probe, close location, retest, and role change.","principle_id":"principle_002_levels_are_zones"}
Teach compact XAUUSD market-structure principles for later LoRA examples.

{"principle_id":"principle_003_acceptance_rejection_balance","source_policy":"Distilled from human doctrine and trading literature principles; no copied book text.","task":"Learn one market-structure principle before reading chart examples.","topic":"auction state"}

{"guardrail":"Apply only when confirmed by closed candles and current market context.","lesson":"Acceptance needs closes and hold beyond the zone; rejection needs a probe and failed close; balance needs two-sided overlap.","practice":"Name the auction state before choosing open, wait, or skip.","principle_id":"principle_003_acceptance_rejection_balance"}
Teach compact XAUUSD market-structure principles for later LoRA examples.

{"principle_id":"principle_004_effort_result_volume","source_policy":"Distilled from human doctrine and trading literature principles; no copied book text.","task":"Learn one market-structure principle before reading chart examples.","topic":"tick-volume effort versus result"}

{"guardrail":"Apply only when confirmed by closed candles and current market context.","lesson":"Volume is context for effort. High volume with limited progress can show absorption; low volume on retest can show weak demand or supply.","practice":"Never use volume alone. Confirm with closed price response at the level.","principle_id":"principle_004_effort_result_volume"}
Teach compact XAUUSD market-structure principles for later LoRA examples.

{"principle_id":"principle_005_candle_position","source_policy":"Distilled from human doctrine and trading literature principles; no copied book text.","task":"Learn one market-structure principle before reading chart examples.","topic":"close location inside candle"}

{"guardrail":"Apply only when confirmed by closed candles and current market context.","lesson":"The close position reveals whether the probe was accepted or rejected better than the wick alone.","practice":"Compare body fraction, upper/lower wick, and final close relative to the tested level.","principle_id":"principle_005_candle_position"}
Teach compact XAUUSD market-structure principles for later LoRA examples.

{"principle_id":"principle_006_h4_candle_sequence","source_policy":"Distilled from human doctrine and trading literature principles; no copied book text.","task":"Learn one market-structure principle before reading chart examples.","topic":"multiple H4 candle flow"}

{"guardrail":"Apply only when confirmed by closed candles and current market context.","lesson":"One H4 candle can leave impulse, rejection, balance, or unfinished auction that the next H4 either accepts or rejects.","practice":"Read prior H4 body, wick, close, and next-candle follow-through before trusting a lower-timeframe trigger.","principle_id":"principle_006_h4_candle_sequence"}
Teach compact XAUUSD market-structure principles for later LoRA examples.

{"principle_id":"principle_007_session_flow","source_policy":"Distilled from human doctrine and trading literature principles; no copied book text.","task":"Learn one market-structure principle before reading chart examples.","topic":"session behavior"}

{"guardrail":"Apply only when confirmed by closed candles and current market context.","lesson":"Asia, London, and overlap alter the meaning of tests. London uses the completed Asia range as structure.","practice":"Do not treat a session sweep, breakout, and retest as the same behavior.","principle_id":"principle_007_session_flow"}
Teach compact XAUUSD market-structure principles for later LoRA examples.

{"principle_id":"principle_008_retest_and_false_break","source_policy":"Distilled from human doctrine and trading literature principles; no copied book text.","task":"Learn one market-structure principle before reading chart examples.","topic":"breakout and retest"}

{"guardrail":"Apply only when confirmed by closed candles and current market context.","lesson":"A wick beyond a level is not a break. A close beyond and held retest supports acceptance; a close back inside is false-break evidence.","practice":"Ask whether old resistance held as support or old support held as resistance.","principle_id":"principle_008_retest_and_false_break"}
Teach compact XAUUSD market-structure principles for later LoRA examples.

{"principle_id":"principle_009_skip_is_a_skill","source_policy":"Distilled from human doctrine and trading literature principles; no copied book text.","task":"Learn one market-structure principle before reading chart examples.","topic":"quality filter"}

{"guardrail":"Apply only when confirmed by closed candles and current market context.","lesson":"No trade is a valid decision when structure is unclear, compressed, off-session, or too close to the next opposing level.","practice":"Force neither direction; express uncertainty through skip or armed wait.","principle_id":"principle_009_skip_is_a_skill"}
Teach compact XAUUSD market-structure principles for later LoRA examples.

{"principle_id":"principle_010_no_lookahead","source_policy":"Distilled from human doctrine and trading literature principles; no copied book text.","task":"Learn one market-structure principle before reading chart examples.","topic":"research discipline"}

{"guardrail":"Apply only when confirmed by closed candles and current market context.","lesson":"Training must use only facts available at the timestamp being explained.","practice":"Never explain a candle using later candles, later outcomes, or daily statistics unavailable at the time.","principle_id":"principle_010_no_lookahead"}

market_structure_lesson.carry_forward_effect: The current H4 should be read as follow-through if it accepts the prior close, as rejection if it probes beyond and closes back, and as balance if it overlaps prior value.
